question: List all students.
reference_sql: select * from students;

question: Find the names and roll numbers of all students.
reference_sql: select name, roll_number from students;

question: Find all female students.
reference_sql: select * from students where gender = 'Female';

question: Find students admitted in 2024.
reference_sql: select * from students where admission_year = 2024;

question: Find students admitted after 2024.
reference_sql: select * from students where admission_year > 2024;

question: List all courses worth 4 credits.
reference_sql: select * from courses where credits = 4;

question: Find all departments located in Block A.
reference_sql: select * from departments where building = 'Block A';

question: Find students whose names start with A.
reference_sql: select * from students where name like 'A%';

question: Display the five most recently admitted students.
reference_sql: select * from students order by admission_year desc, student_id desc limit 5;

question: Count the total number of students.
reference_sql: select count(*) as total_students from students;

question: List each student's name along with their department name.
reference_sql: select s.name, d.department_name from students s join departments d on s.department_id = d.department_id;

question: List each course with the name of its department.
reference_sql: select c.course_name, d.department_name from courses c join departments d on c.department_id = d.department_id;

question: Display the names of students and the courses they are enrolled in.
reference_sql: select s.name, c.course_name from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join courses c on e.course_id = c.course_id;

question: Find the names of students enrolled in Database Management.
reference_sql: select s.name from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join courses c on e.course_id = c.course_id where c.course_name = 'Database Management';

question: Display student names, assessment types and marks obtained.
reference_sql: select s.name, m.assessment_type, m.marks_obtained from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id;

question: List student names, course names and semester numbers for all enrollments.
reference_sql: select s.name, c.course_name, e.semester from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join courses c on e.course_id = c.course_id;

question: Show each department name and the courses offered by it.
reference_sql: select d.department_name, c.course_name from departments d join courses c on d.department_id = c.department_id;

question: Display student roll numbers with the course codes they are enrolled in.
reference_sql: select s.roll_number, c.course_code from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join courses c on e.course_id = c.course_id;

question: Find the names of students, their course names and final examination marks.
reference_sql: select s.name, c.course_name, m.marks_obtained from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join courses c on e.course_id = c.course_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id where m.assessment_type = 'Final';

question: List students with their department names and enrolled course names.
reference_sql: select s.name, d.department_name, c.course_name from students s join departments d on s.department_id = d.department_id join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join courses c on e.course_id = c.course_id;

question: Count the number of students in each department.
reference_sql: select d.department_name, count(s.student_id) as total_students from departments d left join students s on d.department_id = s.department_id group by d.department_id, d.department_name;

question: Find the average marks obtained in all assessments.
reference_sql: select avg(marks_obtained) as average_marks from marks;

question: Find the average marks obtained by students in each course.
reference_sql: select c.course_name, avg(m.marks_obtained) as average_marks from courses c join enrollments e on c.course_id = e.course_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id group by c.course_id, c.course_name;

question: Count the number of courses offered by each department.
reference_sql: select d.department_name, count(c.course_id) as total_courses from departments d left join courses c on d.department_id = c.department_id group by d.department_id, d.department_name;

question: Find the highest marks obtained in each assessment type.
reference_sql: select assessment_type, max(marks_obtained) as highest_marks from marks group by assessment_type;

question: Find the lowest marks obtained in each assessment type.
reference_sql: select assessment_type, min(marks_obtained) as lowest_marks from marks group by assessment_type;

question: Calculate the total marks obtained by each student across all assessments.
reference_sql: select s.student_id, s.name, sum(m.marks_obtained) as total_marks from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id group by s.student_id, s.name;

question: Find departments having more than 15 students.
reference_sql: select d.department_name, count(s.student_id) as total_students from departments d join students s on d.department_id = s.department_id group by d.department_id, d.department_name having count(s.student_id) > 15;

question: Find courses having an average final examination mark above 70.
reference_sql: select c.course_name, avg(m.marks_obtained) as average_final_marks from courses c join enrollments e on c.course_id = e.course_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id where m.assessment_type = 'Final' group by c.course_id, c.course_name having avg(m.marks_obtained) > 70;

question: Find academic years having more than 50 enrollments.
reference_sql: select academic_year, count(*) as total_enrollments from enrollments group by academic_year having count(*) > 50;

question: Find students who obtained marks above the overall average marks.
reference_sql: select distinct s.student_id, s.name from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id where m.marks_obtained > (select avg(marks_obtained) from marks);

question: Find courses in which at least one student is enrolled.
reference_sql: select c.course_id, c.course_name from courses c where exists (select 1 from enrollments e where e.course_id = c.course_id);

question: Find students enrolled in Database Management.
reference_sql: select student_id, name from students where student_id in (select e.student_id from enrollments e join courses c on e.course_id = c.course_id where c.course_name = 'Database Management');

question: Find assessment records where the student's marks are above the average for that assessment type.
reference_sql: select m.mark_id, s.name, m.assessment_type, m.marks_obtained from marks m join enrollments e on m.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id join students s on e.student_id = s.student_id where m.marks_obtained > (select avg(m2.marks_obtained) from marks m2 where m2.assessment_type = m.assessment_type);

question: Find courses whose average final examination marks are above the overall average final examination marks.
reference_sql: select c.course_id, c.course_name, avg(m.marks_obtained) as average_marks from courses c join enrollments e on c.course_id = e.course_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id where m.assessment_type = 'Final' group by c.course_id, c.course_name having avg(m.marks_obtained) > (select avg(marks_obtained) from marks where assessment_type = 'Final');

question: Find departments whose student count is greater than the average student count across all departments.
reference_sql: select d.department_id, d.department_name, count(s.student_id) as total_students from departments d join students s on d.department_id = s.department_id group by d.department_id, d.department_name having count(s.student_id) > (select avg(department_count) from (select count(*) as department_count from students group by department_id));

question: Find departments that have at least one student.
reference_sql: select d.department_id, d.department_name from departments d where exists (select 1 from students s where s.department_id = d.department_id);

question: Find students enrolled in at least one course offered by their own department.
reference_sql: select distinct s.student_id, s.name from students s where exists (select 1 from enrollments e join courses c on e.course_id = c.course_id where e.student_id = s.student_id and c.department_id = s.department_id);

question: Find all assessment records that contain the highest marks for their respective assessment types.
reference_sql: select mark_id, enrollment_id, assessment_type, marks_obtained from marks m where marks_obtained = (select max(m2.marks_obtained) from marks m2 where m2.assessment_type = m.assessment_type);

question: Find students whose total marks across all assessments are greater than the average total marks per student.
reference_sql: select s.student_id, s.name, sum(m.marks_obtained) as total_marks from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id group by s.student_id, s.name having sum(m.marks_obtained) > (select avg(student_total) from (select sum(m2.marks_obtained) as student_total from enrollments e2 join marks m2 on e2.enrollment_id = m2.enrollment_id group by e2.student_id));

question: Find the five students with the highest average final examination marks.
reference_sql: select s.student_id, s.name, avg(m.marks_obtained) as average_marks from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id where m.assessment_type = 'Final' group by s.student_id, s.name order by average_marks desc, s.student_id limit 5;

question: Find the average final examination marks for courses offered by each department.
reference_sql: select d.department_name, avg(m.marks_obtained) as average_marks from departments d join courses c on d.department_id = c.department_id join enrollments e on c.course_id = e.course_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id where m.assessment_type = 'Final' group by d.department_id, d.department_name;

question: Find students enrolled in at least two different courses.
reference_sql: select s.student_id, s.name, count(distinct e.course_id) as total_courses from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id group by s.student_id, s.name having count(distinct e.course_id) >= 2;

question: Find courses whose enrollment count is greater than the average enrollment count across all courses.
reference_sql: select c.course_id, c.course_name, count(e.enrollment_id) as total_enrollments from courses c join enrollments e on c.course_id = e.course_id group by c.course_id, c.course_name having count(e.enrollment_id) > (select avg(course_count) from (select count(*) as course_count from enrollments group by course_id));

question: Find the highest final examination mark obtained in each course.
reference_sql: select c.course_name, max(m.marks_obtained) as highest_marks from courses c join enrollments e on c.course_id = e.course_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id where m.assessment_type = 'Final' group by c.course_id, c.course_name;

question: Find departments that do not offer any courses.
reference_sql: select d.department_id, d.department_name from departments d left join courses c on d.department_id = c.department_id where c.course_id is null;

question: Display each student's name, number of enrolled courses and average marks across all assessments.
reference_sql: select s.student_id, s.name, count(distinct e.course_id) as total_courses, avg(m.marks_obtained) as average_marks from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id group by s.student_id, s.name;

question: Find the three courses with the highest total marks obtained across all assessments.
reference_sql: select c.course_id, c.course_name, sum(m.marks_obtained) as total_marks from courses c join enrollments e on c.course_id = e.course_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id group by c.course_id, c.course_name order by total_marks desc, c.course_id limit 3;

question: Find students enrolled in courses offered by departments other than their own department.
reference_sql: select distinct s.student_id, s.name from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join courses c on e.course_id = c.course_id where c.department_id <> s.department_id;

question: Find students whose average final examination marks are greater than the average final examination marks of students in their own department.
reference_sql: select s.student_id, s.name, avg(m.marks_obtained) as average_marks from students s join enrollments e on s.student_id = e.student_id join marks m on e.enrollment_id = m.enrollment_id where m.assessment_type = 'Final' group by s.student_id, s.name, s.department_id having avg(m.marks_obtained) > (select avg(m2.marks_obtained) from students s2 join enrollments e2 on s2.student_id = e2.student_id join marks m2 on e2.enrollment_id = m2.enrollment_id where s2.department_id = s.department_id and m2.assessment_type = 'Final');
